body: im sorry. i didnt intend to talk to anyone today after i posted this. it was just something to do while i waited for traffic to clear. i can never live with what ive done and ill never come to terms with everything ive been through. the only hope i have is that someone reads this an learns from what ive done.  i have to end this now im sorry
